fixture.note: Explicit density fixture adds normal enemies through spawnEnemy and preserves initial enemies, spawnClock, HP, speed, AI, damage and normal subsequent spawning. Existing Continue/preload/resume UI launches the memory-only checkpoint.

native.note: Original native texture submission and shader API readiness before launch; not GPU completion, measured FPS or first-draw validation. A maximum of three original enemy models is owned until adoption.

playerAlphaRows.note: QA-owned fresh player only. The unchanged original rasterFrame is called once; only its one exact256-square pre-weapon getImageData consumer receives a reusable sparse alpha8 endpoint mask. The mask is never drawn or substituted for original body/colour canvases. GPU row bytes preserve alpha8 bounds and open torso contour, not every original alpha value. verify=true intentionally performs one additional original same-frame Canvas read and is quality-only, not a speed comparison. Timings include synchronous GPU wait and installer overhead, not GPU duration/FPS/peak memory. Custom, repeated, reentrant or changed-owner reads fall back and block acceptance. No caller model, texture, canvas or renderer is disposed.

performance.note: Only cost mode without verification can be performance evidence. Preparation plus40 callbacks plus final drain must improve3% over the faster original; first callback and40/41 p95/max may not regress against either original. GPU row copy/render/read and computational mask work remain inside timing. Strict pixels, literal Game, actual usage with no fallbacks, method/resource cleanup and independent same-frame quality are required. No automatic adoption/FPS/peak-memory claim.

report.note: Explicit own-data playerAlphaRows:true and qa-player-alpha-rows=1: fresh original/player-row-boundary/original owned arms. Only B scopes the unchanged original player raster body-mask read to an exact row-edge computational mask; original colour canvases, poses, weapon, NPC renderer and Game remain unchanged. One body framebuffer copy, one1x256 GPU row pass,1024 read bytes and reusable262144-byte computational mask replace the original full Canvas read; these costs, first shader use and installer reporting are inside callback wall. No prime or new shader/texture preparation. Verify mode adds a same-frame original RGBA read and exact all-row/bounds/contour checks; its timings are quality diagnostics and cannot be accepted as performance evidence. Strict whole-canvas AA/AB gates remain unchanged; previous AA failures remain unresolved. Owned resources and method restoration must pass; no automatic product adoption, FPS or peak-RAM claim. 8851 genuine-memory QA only. Fresh owned Renderer/Art/native player and initial max-three-model NPC preparation per original/manual/original arm. Original on-demand species loads remain enabled; actual runtime model/pending maxima are reported. Main ready records are borrowed by identity and never loaded, masked or released through a mutating path. Forty fixed .12-second catch-up callbacks include their first draw; batch-eight rAF yields are reported separately. This is a renderer combat harness without app HUD, audio or persistence, not presented FPS. Certification and lifecycle wrappers are inside render timing in every arm; no Canvas-stage, native-stage or frame-cost observer is installed. Literal per-frame checkpoint/effects/motion/commands/events and both RNG states are compared outside timers. Final whole-canvas readback and PNG export follow the measured loop. Existing twelve-state/two-selected-cell pixel QA is separate evidence, not proof for every source frame. Shared URL decode caches and the live product caches remain resident; fresh instances do not imply cold driver/URL caches. Owned native pending promises are followed through late success/failure for retirement. A failed player Promise.all can have unobservable sibling requests; that failure is explicitly cleanup-unproven rather than called complete. Timings are CPU call wall, not GPU duration or peak memory. No product optimization is adopted by this utility.

readbackStorage.note: Three sequential final-canvas readback arrays and at most three PNG strings are retained until comparison, then raw arrays are dropped; source-pixel storage only, not a peak-memory measurement.
